title: Apple Inc. Annual Report (10-K) FY2023
content: Apple Inc. designs, manufactures and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories. Total net sales for fiscal year 2023 were $383.3 billion, down 3% compared to $394.3 billion in fiscal year 2022. Net income was $97.0 billion. Services revenue reached an all-time record of $85.2 billion, growing 9% year-over-year. iPhone revenue was $200.6 billion. The Company generated $114.1 billion in operating cash flow.
risk_factors: Regulatory scrutiny in App Store business

title: Microsoft Corporation Annual Report (10-K) FY2023
content: Microsoft Corporation enables digital transformation for the era of an intelligent cloud and an intelligent edge. Revenue for fiscal year 2023 was $211.9 billion, up 7% from $198.3 billion in fiscal year 2022. Net income was $72.4 billion. Cloud revenue (Intelligent Cloud segment) grew 19% to $87.9 billion. Azure and other cloud services grew 27%. Microsoft 365 commercial revenue grew 13%.
risk_factors: Competition from Google Cloud and AWS

title: Alphabet Inc. Annual Report (10-K) FY2023
content: Alphabet Inc. is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. Revenue for 2023 was $307.4 billion, an increase of 9% compared to 2022. Net income was $73.8 billion. Google Cloud revenue was $33.1 billion, up 26%. Google Search revenue was $175.0 billion. YouTube advertising revenue was $31.5 billion.
risk_factors: Competition in search from AI-powered alternatives
